inverter.title: Inverter
inverter.description: Pick the first TOU slot SOC entity (for example number.<prefix>_tou_1_battery_soc) to prefill the other slots by pattern.

slots.title: TOU slots
slots.description: For each slot choose the SOC cap number, the optional start time entity, and either the inverter's per-slot grid charging switch (read live, never written) or the fallback Charge checkbox.

data.load_sensor: House load power sensor (W or kW)
data.ev_sensors: EV charger power sensors (W or kW)

roles.title: Slot roles
roles.description: Assign a role and start time to every slot. Hold roles keep the battery at the target SOC on cloudy days (floor on sunny days); spend roles run it down to the floor. Whether a slot can grid-charge is decided by its Charge setting on the inverter, not by its role.

error.duplicate_slot_entity: Each slot needs its own SOC entity.
error.forecast_entity_required: Choose the forecast entity when using an external source.
error.no_charge_slot: At least one slot must have the overnight or charge role (the slots that carry the cloudy-day target).
error.energy_not_power: PV, load and EV inputs must be power sensors (W or kW), not energy sensors (kWh).

data.afternoon_share: Afternoon PV share used against the evening need

options.overnight: Overnight - hold the target on cloudy days
options.morning: Morning - hold the target on cloudy days
options.charge: Charge slot - hold the target on cloudy days (grid charges here if Charge is on)
options.peak: Peak - spend down to the floor
options.evening: Evening - spend down to the floor

slot_unavailable.title: Inverter slot entities unavailable
slot_unavailable.description: TOU slot entities {slots} have been unavailable for over 30 minutes. The planner writes nothing until all slot entities are available.

write_reverted.title: Slot {slot} write keeps reverting
write_reverted.description: The inverter did not keep the value written to slot {slot} after a retry. Writes to this slot are stopped until the next plan.

write_budget_exceeded.title: Write budget exceeded
write_budget_exceeded.description: The planner would have exceeded {budget} writes per hour and was turned off to guard against oscillation. Check the desired caps and re-enable it when ready.

overnight_charge_disabled.title: No grid-charge slot has Charge enabled
overnight_charge_disabled.description: No slot with the overnight or charge role has grid charging enabled on the inverter, so the cloudy profile cannot grid-charge the battery.
